Recorded claim:
Build and run from one matching checkout/build configuration. A copied binary with manually overlaid frontend resources causes API/source mismatch and is invalid validation. Local packaging experiments must be separate unstaged diffs and may demonstrate only the modified experiment. [Task 2]
